title: Support.
officialText:
All suspended scaffold support devices, such as outrigger beams, C-hooks, parapet clamps, and similar
devices shall be supported by surfaces capable of supporting at least 4 times the load imposed on them by the scaffold operating
at the rated load of the hoist. The support shall be inspected prior to installation in accordance with the requirements of Section
3314.4.3.1.
